username.description: OpenStack username with appropriate permissions (e.g., for fencing)

password.description: Password for the OpenStack user. Keep secret!

project_name.description: OpenStack project (tenant) name containing the target VMs to fence

region.description: Optional OpenStack region (e.g., 'regionOne'). If omitted, the default region is used.

api_version.description: Optional OpenStack API version override (e.g., '3'). Usually auto-detected.

endpoint_overrides.description: List of custom endpoint overrides (e.g., to point to internal/alternative services)

value.description: Full URL for the custom endpoint

insecure.description: Disable SSL certificate verification (use only in test environments)

cafile.description: Path to a custom CA bundle PEM file for SSL verification

certfile.description: Path to a client certificate PEM file for mutual TLS (optional)
